description: Generation: the interchange at layer 0 of the prompt, then three greedy tokens, with the head read at the last position of calls 0, 1 and 2 — {'frame': k, 'index': -1}, swept so each call is a point: the prefill's last prompt token, then generated tokens 0 and 1 as inputs, whose logits are the distributions over tokens 0, 1 and 2. Does a patch made once at the prefill still move what the model says two tokens later? It reaches the continuation only through the cache. `patched` — the step itself — is the ids it generated, saved beside the metric.
